interface_rule: R046 specifies only engineering target constraints. It neither declares allowed native ontology beyond UNSPECIFIED nor selects a collapse/growth mechanism.
global_forbidden_imported_effective_defi: classical π numerical value or decimal expansion as a selection loss
Euclidean length/area/volume/measure as undeclared native input
continuum point set or PDE as undeclared native input
any definition algebraically equivalent to the target output and inserted to force recovery

forbidden_imported_effective_definitions: classical π value or decimal target
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Use multiple independently calibrated measurement channels on a controlled family of closed-boundary manufactured specimens: profile/reindexing, wrap traversal, boundary-sampled enclosed measure, swept-transfer flow, and gravimetric capacity. The native proposal must produce a bridge whose predictions can be compared to these outputs without using any of their classical geometric descriptors as native inputs.
constraints.required_scale_range: Must cover the scale regimes actually declared by the constituent protocols, including millimetre-centimetre aperture metrology, cited liquid-flow ranges, and cited litre-scale gravimetric capacity ranges.
constraints.required_tolerance: Protocol-specific; at minimum must not exceed the cited measurement envelopes for the channels used. No single universal π tolerance is substituted for these channel errors.
composition_requirements: profile/traversal/enclosed-measure channels must be predicted from one candidate mechanism/bridge without per-channel target-definition insertion
transverse-measure × displacement -> transferred quantity -> time rate must compose within flow uncertainty
gravimetric capacity must agree with transferred/enclosed quantity within its calibration uncertainty

forbidden_imported_effective_definitions: classical π value or decimal target
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Compare finite recurring mechanical and electronic processes using return-to-reference, time displacement, cycle fraction and drift measurements. Angular units may appear only after prediction as an effective reporting convention.
constraints.required_scale_range: At least one mechanical full-cycle indexing regime and the cited low-frequency electronic phase-calibration range, with protocol-specific extensions allowed.
constraints.required_tolerance: Must meet each selected indexing and phase/time calibration envelope; no radians-based tolerance is privileged.
composition_requirements: successive cycle fractions compose to the observed return state
relative displacement drift must agree with independently measured frequency offset/time evolution
the same mechanism may be shared across apparatus only if sharing is derived rather than inserted by unit convention

forbidden_imported_effective_definitions: classical π value or decimal target
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Apply a localized controlled perturbation to a prepared specimen, observe the time-resolved response at declared locations/channels, and compare characteristic relaxation/spread and conservation behavior across specimen scale/material state. A continuum/Gaussian fit is permitted only as a downstream effective readout.
constraints.required_scale_range: The experimentally validated laser-flash specimen/material regimes used for the comparison; any extrapolation must be separately declared.
constraints.required_tolerance: Experiment-specific transient/diffusivity uncertainty and declared measurement-error model; no Gaussian amplitude-normalization target.
composition_requirements: predicted response must preserve the experimentally observed scale/time dependence
if coarse-grained kernels are produced, their normalization must follow from the bridge/readout rather than be inserted into native premises

forbidden_imported_effective_definitions: continuum wave equation as native premise
Euclidean cavity geometry as native premise
classical π value or decimal target
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Prepare a bounded resonant apparatus, excite identifiable modes, measure repeated resonance frequencies and perturbations, independently track apparatus/material state, and compare distinct acoustic and microwave channels. Continuum mode labels may be assigned only after the native prediction/bridge exists.
constraints.required_scale_range: The cited precision cavity/resonator regimes and temperature ranges used for the selected comparison.
constraints.required_tolerance: Must reproduce selected resonance frequencies/shifts and cross-channel state tracking within the cited ppm/sub-ppm fractional-frequency envelopes.
composition_requirements: mode ordering/spacing and state-dependent shifts must be predicted coherently rather than fitted one scalar at a time
independent acoustic/microwave channels must be explainable by a shared state only if that shared state is derived

foundation_calibration_separation.FOUNDATION: derive candidate native mechanism/bridge without access to target definitions or the classical π value as a selection criterion
foundation_calibration_separation.CALIBRATION: only after the candidate is frozen, compare predicted observables with K_eng protocols/scales/tolerances
foundation_calibration_separation.pass_condition: multi-member K_eng coverage with declared errors and no target leakage
foundation_calibration_separation.fail_condition: one-number fit, hidden effective definition, or unexplained member outside tolerance
